Exploratory (not hypotheses): the nine untrained founders with their frozen templates (sealed_runs_exploratory.tsv), run after the 13 primary runs; no EXP-CZ-010/011 adapter is run on sealed set 3 (owner decision 2026-10-25); Holm-adjusted if ranked
revealed.decision_rule: H17.1 and H17.2: Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05 and child minus parent >= 5 points (in whole tasks: 100 x difference >= 5 x 2,393). H17.3: Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05 in either direction. H17.4a and H17.4b: Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05 and child minus solver control >= 2 points. Holm is over exactly these five tests. H17.5 per child (Theo, Hazel): the one-sided 95% Wald lower bound of rate(Q4_K_M) - rate(Q8_0) on paired outcomes, d - 1.6449 x sqrt(((b + c) - (b - c)^2 / n) / n^2), is above -0.02; if not, the child ships as Q8_0. Replications: the same five tests for seed 1 and for seed 2 (each its own Holm family of five); a seed-0 success whose difference has the opposite sign in both replications is reported as not robust. Membership: a child joins only if its seed-0 Q8_0 run passes R1 exactly as in EXP-CZ-001 (Wilson lower bound of E1 >= 0.25, E2 >= 0.90, E1 above the trivial baseline's upper bound; trivial baseline read back from the 13 planned ledgers). Every number comes from cz paired with experiments/EXP-CZ-017/analysis_plan.json.
revealed.failure_criteria: A run is void, and reported, if its ledger fails verification, its result JSON disagrees with the ledger, its tasks_sha256 differs from the sealed set 3 scored file, its model_id, template or weight_sha256 differs from this manifest, it is not greedy, or it lacks one verdict per task. A void run counts as an untested hypothesis (p = 1) in its Holm family and supports nothing. The driver refuses a row whose GGUF, runner or sealed file differs from the frozen sha256.
hypotheses: On sealed set 3, greedy, P3, 512 tokens, Q8_0 children of seed 0, exact McNemar, Holm over the five tests H17.1 to H17.4:
H17.1 Theo solves at least 5 points more than the parent, and the difference is significant.
H17.2 Hazel solves at least 5 points more than the parent, and the difference is significant.
H17.3 Theo and Hazel differ (two-sided, no direction predicted). This is the head-to-head.
H17.4a and H17.4b Each child solves at least 2 points more than the solver control, and the difference is significant.
H17.5 For each child, Q4_K_M loses no more than 2 points against Q8_0 (one-sided 95% lower bound of the paired difference above -0.02). If it fails, the child ships as Q8_0.
Seeds 1 and 2 are reported for every arm; a hypothesis that holds for seed 0 but reverses in both replications is reported as not robust.
revealed.primary_endpoint: E1 (greedy verified solve rate on the 2,393 scored tasks of sealed set 3, Wilson 95%) for the parent and each child; the paired differences of H17.1 to H17.4b with exact two-sided McNemar, Holm over those five tests (alpha 0.05); H17.5 one-sided 95% lower bound of the Q4_K_M minus Q8_0 paired difference. Also E1 to E4 as in EXP-CZ-001 (E4 not applicable), per family and per cell with json_extract d4 and d5 marked exempt, GGUF bytes, peak VRAM and tokens per second from the run logs, each child's share of training examples per cell (train-shared summary), API requests, tokens and USD per teacher, GPU minutes per arm.
